en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa ibn ‘Ubayd from Yunus from Hisham ibn al-Hakam who has said the following. “I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words Glorious is Allah.”
The Imam said, “It means Distinction of Allah (His being free of all shortcomings).”
en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from Yunus, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about ‘Glorious is Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Respect of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
